title: AI made Iron Man For Marvel Fans until Insominac Does Something - New and more footage
author: alphapokemonop
selftext:
Gameplay footage of an Iron Man Game.

Made using Opus 5.5, Low fps because poor PC and I decided to film on high graphics  
I was genuinely impressed by its attempt for generating that world and all animations by hand, no reference  
Credits to models for the rightful owners.

comments.author: deReaLizedGames
comments.body:
I thought this was pretty damn cool, obviously it's rough and lacks polish but it has serious potential. Love that you can switch to first person, and the hands firing in first person looked really fun.

I don't understand why people are being so mean. This should be a community where we support each other, not tear each other down. If you think there's room for improvement, give constructive feedback with actual suggestions for improvements ("I think the game would benefit from improved UI"). I'm sorry this was the response you got OP. Though after looking at the comment history of one of these posters, they're just chronically negative. That's honestly a sad way to live, I genuinely hope they get some therapy because they're just constantly feeling negative emotions when they don't have to live like that.

replies.author: alphapokemonop
replies.body: Thanks for being supportive, I am not a developer to publish this to steam or itch, it was just a fan-made game, just experimenting with ai, testing its capabilities. I thought this community was to share exactly that.
